title: Glasshouse and Inventory
author: E. M. Vasquez
blurb: Wren Vane, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
